purpose: Fifty non-identifying conversation domains for a factorized PersonaPlex semantic-control corpus. Every domain must yield twenty distinct premises and ten eligible trajectories while reusing the same three causal operators across unrelated topics so held-out evaluation measures learned control rather than scenario memorization.

interactionRequirements.controlFrameRule: Every agent target receives a compact declarative control frame before its first supervised frame. The frame contains causal state, evidence status, next goal, constraints, posture, delivery style, revision, and turn-taking state, but never target transcript, target audio, a target hash, or wording that reconstructs the label.
interactionRequirements.factorizationRule: The semantic, delivery, and turn-taking operators must repeat across many unrelated premises and across all dataset splits. Four siblings share byte-identical native history through the pivot and differ by one typed control value; composite interventions are rejected rather than certified by a widened token budget.
